'''Quetemoor the Venerable''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mugaari]] who was one of the co-leaders of a Mugaari criminal family that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Quetemoor shared power with his son [[Quetemoor the Sub-Elder]] and his relatives [[Quetemoor the Elder]] and [[Quetemoor the Younger]].
